modules.title: 同一提交连跑五次为何会红绿交替
不稳定不是可以忽略的偶发失败

items.title: 先确认代码没有变化却结果变化
items.text: 同一版本、同一用例连续运行出现通过和失败，说明测试、环境或并发条件中有不可控因素。每次必然失败更像可复现缺陷，排查路径不同。

items.title: 找可观察的波动来源
items.text: 检查是否等待了真正完成信号、多个用例是否共享账号或端口、数据是否残留，以及 CI 与本地环境是否不同。记录失败次数和日志，再修正根因。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 不稳定测试不是普通的单次失败，也不是靠重试就修好的测试。重试可能让流水线暂时继续或提供复现信息，但若不处理根因，团队会慢慢不再相信红灯。

lessonPractice.title: 同一 commit 的登录测试运行五次，结果是通过、通过、失败、通过、失败，失败原因都是超时。第一步应该做什么？

options.label: 保留运行记录，检查等待条件、共享账号和 CI 环境差异，设法稳定复现
options.feedback: 对。同一代码交替结果是波动证据，应先找不可控因素。

options.label: 把重试次数调到无限，直到流水线变绿
options.feedback: 这会隐藏信号、增加时间，不能消除不稳定根因。

options.label: 直接按每次都能复现的产品缺陷处理，不必比较运行条件
options.feedback: 它可能也暴露真实问题，但先要区分为什么同一测试有时通过。

en.title: A login test on the same commit passes, passes, fails, passes, then fails, and both failures time out. What should you do first?

options.label: Keep run evidence, inspect wait conditions, shared accounts, and CI differences, then make it reproduce stably
options.feedback: Correct. Alternating results on unchanged code are evidence of variance, so find the uncontrolled factor.

options.label: Set retries to infinite until the pipeline turns green
options.feedback: That hides signal and adds time; it does not remove the instability cause.

options.label: Treat it directly like a defect that always reproduces, without comparing run conditions
options.feedback: It may reveal a real product issue too, but first distinguish why the same test sometimes passes.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 这个登录测试在同一提交上偶发超时。请连续运行并保留每次日志，检查等待条件、共享账号和测试数据；先找出可复现的波动原因，不要只增加重试次数。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: This login test times out intermittently on the same commit. Run it repeatedly and retain each log, inspect wait conditions, shared accounts, and test data; find a reproducible source of variance before merely increasing retries.

learning.assumes: You know automated tests should give stable results under the same conditions.
learning.outcome: You can recognize flakiness from alternating red and green on one version and first inspect waiting, shared resources, and environment differences.

modules.title: Why five runs of one commit alternate red and green
Flaky does not mean harmless occasional failure

items.title: Confirm unchanged code, changing result
items.text: Passing and failing on the same version and case points to an uncontrolled test, environment, or concurrency condition. A case that always fails is more like a reproducible defect and needs a different path.

items.title: Look for observable sources of variance
items.text: Check whether the test waits for a true completion signal, cases share an account or port, data remains, or CI differs from local. Record failure frequency and logs, then fix the cause.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: A flaky test is neither an ordinary one-off failure nor a test fixed by retries. Retries can temporarily continue a pipeline or gather reproduction information, but unaddressed flakiness makes teams stop trusting red lights.

distinctions.label: Regression test
distinctions.text: A {c:flaky-test} alternates between pass and fail even when code is unchanged. A {c:regression-test} should reliably judge whether a change broke existing behavior.
